fin_h: Your next holiday in Val di Sole starts here
faq6_a: At Via Brescia 58, Presson hamlet, in Dimaro Folgarida (TN), Val di Sole, between the Brenta Dolomites, the Stelvio National Park and the Adamello Brenta Natural Park.
faq5_a: Fill in the request with dates, guests and room type, or write or call us: you will receive a personalised stay proposal, with no obligation.
faq5_q: How do I request a stay proposal?
faq4_a: Access to the wellness areas is not allowed for children under 14 years of age. To use them, please inform the reception as soon as possible.
faq4_q: Can children use the wellness areas?
faq3_a: The Val di Sole Guest Card is included in your stay. At the hotel you will find free Wi-Fi, a ski room with boot warmers, a private garage and outdoor parking, a lift and rooms with SKY channels.
faq3_q: What will I find at the hotel?
faq2_a: In the Junior Suites, Natural Wellness in the garden and the Mela Verde Oasis are included, with SPAbag, bathrobe and towel; individual Jacuzzis work with a token. In Standard rooms access to the Oasis is free, while Natural Wellness in the garden has a supplement.
faq2_q: Is wellness included in the stay?
faq1_a: The free hotel minibus takes you in a few minutes to Daolasa, in the Folgarida Marilleva ski area. The stop of the free ski bus is right in front of the hotel and lets you ski at Passo del Tonale too.
faq1_q: How do I get to the ski slopes?
